warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).
Doors ป2-ป4 print two widths (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70): the outer one is the frame (width_m), the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Every door is 2.05 high to ระดับพื้นห้อง.
น1 prints sill 0.85 + window 1.10 against an overall 2.05 (adds to 1.95) — kept the printed values, flagged.
Door/window widths and heights are each opening's own detail dimensions — kept here, not made into grid lines.
